title: A Fixed Return Configuration
statement: For every bit-list input $x$ and every configuration of the increment machine on $x$ whose control is the return state, one step leaves the entire configuration unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration of the increment machine on $x$
The control state of $c$ is the return state
replaced: For every configuration of the increment machine whose control is the return state, one step leaves the entire configuration unchanged, so any upper bound on the running time can be cut to the actual first return.
